earthquakes.note: Observed intervals, coherence, phase and correction readiness. Validated LOS remains null.

wildfires.note: Repeated cross-pol change and event context. Burned area and cause remain unestimated.

deforestation.note: Measured vegetation-disturbance examples. Permanent conversion and classifier accuracy remain unverified.

floods.note: Signed backscatter, diagnostic signatures and dated independent evidence where supported.

landslides.note: Aftermath-only acquisitions starting in June. The January landslide is outside the visible radar bracket.

agriculture.note: Measured focal-versus-annulus examples and a training-region backscatter history. Crop type and health remain unestimated.

volcanoes.note: One measured GUNW pair for phase and coherence. Eruption attribution and motion remain unestimated.

wetlands.note: Measured scattering histories and optical comparisons where supported.

subsidence.note: One measured GUNW pair. Reference stability, corrected displacement and vertical rate remain unverified.

ice.note: No verified ice-targeted measurement was found in the inspected case sources. GOFF is outside the implemented worker contract.

cubes.title: Niscemi landslide aftermath, Italy
cubes.teaches: Available radar passes begin months after the January 25 landslide. The baseline and target are both aftermath observations.

cubes.title: Deliblato Sands fire vicinity, Serbia
cubes.teaches: Measured HH/HV history brackets the reported fire. The window has no independently mapped burn population.

cubes.title: Forest River, North Dakota
cubes.teaches: Use this measured cropland-region history to explore co-/cross-pol changes. Local management timing is unresolved.

cubes.title: Pantanal wetland, Brazil
cubes.teaches: Eight supported passes illustrate wetland backscatter and the frozen Transformer geographic test. Interpolation was slightly better.

cubes.title: Hokkaido geographic test, Japan
cubes.teaches: Measured history for a frozen Transformer reconstruction test. Interpolation and the GP baseline outperformed it.

cubes.title: Wheatbelt control, Western Australia
cubes.teaches: Measured baseline departure and physical fingerprint. The control includes a small optical new-water group.

holdouts.title: Råbelöv wheat trial, Sweden
holdouts.teaches: The Aug 3 recorded harvest is bracketed by July 19 and Aug 12. The full harvested footprint is unresolved.

holdouts.title: Gotland wheat trial, Sweden
holdouts.teaches: The Aug 16 trial harvest falls between July 27 and Aug 20. The measured focal contrast was small.

holdouts.title: Platte Valley comparison, Nebraska
holdouts.teaches: The focal-versus-annulus comparison uses five passes. The prior mapped land cover provides context for the point.

holdouts.title: Timber Fire vicinity, California
holdouts.teaches: The measured HV persistence rule and separately dated OPERA vegetation-loss comparison have different support.

holdouts.title: Weiser Knoll fire vicinity, Wyoming
holdouts.teaches: The first track returned no usable pixels. This is the measured alternate-track comparison.

holdouts.title: Tzermiado flood / Sentinel-1 comparison, Crete
holdouts.teaches: The Oct 4 NISAR pass followed the mapped Sentinel-1 observation by about 53 minutes.

holdouts.title: Tzermiado flood / optical comparison, Crete
holdouts.teaches: This is a second observation window for the same flood. NISAR followed the mapped GeoEye-1 observation by about 32 hours.

holdouts.title: Baja California Sur flood-context comparison
holdouts.teaches: The optical snapshots preserved 179 usable comparison cells, all stable nonwater.
